camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public RetrieveKnowledgePoints --region cn-hangzhou --Query '销售额如何计算，来自哪些表？'
description_en: Searches one or more authorized knowledge bases for knowledge points and returns summaries, relationship paths, and candidates for ambiguous references
description_zh: 在授权的一个或多个知识库中检索知识点，返回摘要、关系路径和歧义候选
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public retrieve-knowledge-points --query '销售额如何计算，来自哪些表？' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RetrieveKnowledgePoints

parameters.example: 销售额如何计算，来自哪些表？
parameters.help_en: The natural language question. The length cannot exceed 256 Unicode code points after leading and trailing whitespaces are removed
parameters.help_zh: 自然语言问题，去首尾空白后不超过256个Unicode码点
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: A list of 1 to 50 unique knowledge base IDs that restricts the search. If you omit this parameter, the operation discovers knowledge bases within the caller’s authorized scope. If you provide IDs, the operation checks access to each knowledge base and the entire request fails if the caller lacks access to any of them
parameters.help_zh: 限定检索的知识库 ID 列表，1～50 个且不能重复。省略时在当前调用者授权范围内发现；显式指定的知识库逐一鉴权，任一无权限则整次请求失败
parameters.name: knowledge_base_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of hits across all knowledge bases. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50. This parameter does not specify the quota for each knowledge base or the page size
parameters.help_zh: 所有知识库合并后的最多命中数量，默认 10，取值 1～50；不是每个知识库的配额，也不是翻页大小
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The location ID of the knowledge point. Copy this value exactly as it appears in the search results and use it together with the corresponding KnowledgeBaseId and Type. Do not parse or convert this value
fields.help_zh: 知识点定位 ID。请从检索结果原样复制，并与所属 KnowledgeBaseId、Type 一起使用，不要自行解析或转换
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the knowledge point belongs. This parameter is used together with Type and Id to locate the knowledge point
fields.help_zh: 知识点所属的知识库 ID。与 Type、Id 一起定位知识点
fields.name: knowledge_base_id

fields.help_en: The read category of the knowledge point. Use GRAPH for the current focus objects and graph nodes
fields.help_zh: 知识点读取类别。当前聚焦对象和图节点使用 GRAPH
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The graph objects to focus the search on. You can specify up to 2 unique objects. The objects must be within the current authorized search scope and do not expand permissions
parameters.help_zh: 聚焦检索的图对象，最多 2 个且不能重复。对象必须处于当前授权检索范围内，不扩大权限
parameters.name: focus_objects

schema.description_en: The successful response of the operation

Code.description_en: The business error code. This field may be omitted if the request succeeds. If the request fails, the common error response protocol applies
Code.description_zh: 业务错误代码。成功时可省略；失败遵循公共错误响应协议

Data.description_en: The knowledge point summaries, relationship paths, ambiguity candidates, and warnings for the current search
Data.description_zh: 本次检索的知识点摘要、关系路径、歧义候选和提示

Ambiguities.description_en: The ambiguity descriptions and candidate objects returned when the target is not yet confirmed
Ambiguities.description_zh: 尚未确认目标时返回的歧义描述及候选对象

Candidates.description_en: The candidate graph nodes when ambiguity exists. Each candidate carries the KnowledgeBaseId, Type, and Id for reading details, which does not indicate that the user has confirmed the selection
Candidates.description_zh: 存在歧义时的候选图节点。候选携带可读取详情的 KnowledgeBaseId、Type、Id，不表示用户已确认选择

Id.description_en: The location ID of the knowledge point. Copy this value exactly as it appears in the search results and use it together with the corresponding KnowledgeBaseId and Type. Do not parse or convert this value
Id.description_zh: 知识点定位 ID。请从检索结果原样复制，并与所属 KnowledgeBaseId、Type 一起使用，不要自行解析或转换

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the knowledge point belongs. This parameter is used together with Type and Id to locate the knowledge point
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 知识点所属的知识库 ID。与 Type、Id 一起定位知识点

Title.description_en: The display title of the current knowledge point
Title.description_zh: 当前知识点的展示标题

Type.description_en: The read category of the knowledge point. Use GRAPH for the current focus objects and graph nodes
Type.description_zh: 知识点读取类别。当前聚焦对象和图节点使用 GRAPH

Mention.description_en: The name or description of the object whose referent is not yet determined in the query
Mention.description_zh: 查询中尚未确定所指对象的名称或描述

Paths.description_en: The relationship paths matched by the search. Path indexes do not correspond to indexes in the Results array. The paths may cover only a subset of relationships
Paths.description_zh: 本次检索匹配的对象关系路径，与 Results 不按数组下标配对；不承诺穷尽全部关系

Edges.description_en: The directed relationships that connect the nodes in the Nodes array of the current path
Edges.description_zh: 连接本条路径 Nodes 中节点的有向关系

FromId.description_en: The Id of the start node in the Nodes array of the same path
FromId.description_zh: 同一路径 Nodes 中起点节点的 Id

RelationType.description_en: The public relationship type directed from the start node to the end node. For example, CALCULATED_FROM indicates that the start node is calculated based on the end node. You cannot infer the complete formula based solely on the relationship type
RelationType.description_zh: 从起点指向终点的公开关系类型。例如 CALCULATED_FROM 表示起点基于终点计算；不能仅凭类型推断完整公式

ToId.description_en: The Id of the end node in the Nodes array of the same path
ToId.description_zh: 同一路径 Nodes 中终点节点的 Id

Nodes.description_en: The graph nodes in the relationship path. You can read the details of each node by using its KnowledgeBaseId, Type, and Id
Nodes.description_zh: 本条关系路径中的图节点。每个节点可通过 KnowledgeBaseId、Type、Id 读取详情

Id.description_en: The location ID of the knowledge point. Copy this value exactly as it appears in the search results and use it together with the corresponding KnowledgeBaseId and Type. Do not parse or convert this value
Id.description_zh: 知识点定位 ID。请从检索结果原样复制，并与所属 KnowledgeBaseId、Type 一起使用，不要自行解析或转换

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the knowledge point belongs. This parameter is used together with Type and Id to locate the knowledge point
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 知识点所属的知识库 ID。与 Type、Id 一起定位知识点

Title.description_en: The display title of the current knowledge point
Title.description_zh: 当前知识点的展示标题

Type.description_en: The read category of the knowledge point. Use GRAPH for the current focus objects and graph nodes
Type.description_zh: 知识点读取类别。当前聚焦对象和图节点使用 GRAPH

Results.description_en: Knowledge point summaries ranked by relevance across all knowledge bases. The total number of results does not exceed MaxResults. Results can include GRAPH, WIKI, and KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT
Results.description_zh: 按统一相关性返回的知识点摘要，跨库总数不超过 MaxResults。可包含 GRAPH、WIKI 和 KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT

Id.description_en: The location ID of the knowledge point. Copy this value exactly as it appears in the search results and use it together with the corresponding KnowledgeBaseId and Type. Do not parse or convert this value
Id.description_zh: 知识点定位 ID。请从检索结果原样复制，并与所属 KnowledgeBaseId、Type 一起使用，不要自行解析或转换

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the knowledge point belongs. This parameter is used together with Type and Id to locate the knowledge point
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 知识点所属的知识库 ID。与 Type、Id 一起定位知识点

Sources.description_en: The download information of the uploaded original documents explicitly associated with the current content. This parameter is omitted if no reliable source is available or if the caller lacks read permissions for the original files. The ability to retrieve knowledge points does not imply the permission to download the complete original files
Sources.description_zh: 当前内容明确关联的上传原文档下载信息。无可靠来源或无原文件读取权限时省略；可检索知识点不代表可以下载完整原文件

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary HTTPS download URL of the original file. The URL is valid for 2 hours. This parameter is returned only when the source can be reliably located and the caller has read permissions for the original file. Do not forward the URL publicly or store it for a long time
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 原文件的 HTTPS 临时下载地址，有效期为 2 小时。仅在来源可可靠定位且调用者有原文件读取权限时返回；请勿公开转发或长期保存

ExpirationTime.description_en: The expiration time of the download URL. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ExpirationTime.description_zh: 下载地址的过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

FileName.description_en: The full file name of the original document used for building. This is not the name of the current knowledge point segment
FileName.description_zh: 构建使用的完整原文档文件名，不是当前知识点片段名称

Summary.description_en: The readable summary of the knowledge point. The summary is not guaranteed to contain the complete content. To obtain details, call GetKnowledgePoint
Summary.description_zh: 知识点的可读摘要，不保证包含完整内容；需要详情时调用 GetKnowledgePoint
Summary.example: 销售额指标及其关联订单表。

Title.description_en: The display title of the current knowledge point
Title.description_zh: 当前知识点的展示标题

Type.description_en: The read category of the knowledge point. GRAPH indicates a local graph, WIKI indicates a topic page, and KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT indicates knowledge content
Type.description_zh: 知识点读取类别：GRAPH 为局部图，WIKI 为主题页面，KNOWLEDGE_CONTENT 为知识内容

Warnings.description_en: The truncation, scope limitation, or degradation warnings for the current call. Use Code for programmatic judgment. Message is for reading purposes only
Warnings.description_zh: 本次调用的裁剪、范围受限或降级提示。根据 Code 判断，Message 仅用于阅读说明

Code.description_en: The truncation or degradation warning code. For example, CONTENT_TRUNCATED indicates that the content is truncated, and SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE indicates that the original file download is temporarily unavailable
Code.description_zh: 裁剪或降级提示码。例如 CONTENT_TRUNCATED 表示内容有裁剪，SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE 表示原文下载暂不可用

Message.description_en: The sanitized readable description of the current warning. Use Code for programmatic judgment instead of relying on the text
Message.description_zh: 当前提示的安全化可读说明。程序判断请使用 Code，不依赖文案
Message.example: 部分内容超过长度限制，已裁剪。

Message.description_en: A human-readable description of the business error. This field may be omitted if the request succeeds. Provide the RequestId when troubleshooting failures
Message.description_zh: 业务错误的可读说明，成功时可省略。失败定位时请同时提供 RequestId

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
